title: Tenant Manager UI
objective: Permission-bound Tenant Manager screens: tenant list (incl. removed where permitted), add/view/edit forms, soft-remove and restore flows (spec FR-06/FR-07, PRD 5.5).
scope: List with status chips (Active/Removed) and include-removed filter (permission-gated)
Add/Edit form: tenant name, contact name, contact email, contact phone with validation per UI standards
Remove (danger dialog restating soft-delete consequence) and Restore actions
out_of_scope: Reference template management UI (covered by Settings global scope, T-016 if permitted)
implementation_details: features/tenantManager/TenantListPage.tsx: table (Name, Contact, Email, Phone, Status chip, actions), include-removed toggle only when tenants.view_removed permission, + New Tenant button
TenantFormPage.tsx shared for add/edit: required name, email format validation, inline errors on blur/submit, sticky footer Cancel/Save
RemoveTenantDialog (danger style: 'Remove tenant — {name}': restates soft delete and restorability); RestoreTenantDialog
RTK Query endpoints tenantsApi: list/get/create/update/remove/restore invalidating tags
Nav entry appears only with tenants.view permission (already gated by T-013 nav config)

e2e: tenant-manager.spec.ts: internal user creates tenant -> appears with Active chip and seeded reference data visible under Settings; edit contact fields persists; remove -> disappears from default list, visible with include-removed, restore reactivates; user without tenant permissions sees no Tenant Manager nav and gets Forbidden on deep link

findings.description: The corrected handleBlur behavior (bug fix: undefined-valued keys no longer stored in fieldErrors, which previously inflated the 3+-error summary threshold and produced a phantom error-summary banner after three valid blurs) is not directly locked by a component test. None of the TenantFormPage tests blur three valid fields and assert form-error-summary does NOT appear. The fix is correct on inspection and indirectly exercised by the passing V-006 e2e (the Save click lands correctly), but a focused unit test would prevent silent reintroduction.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that fills a valid name + valid email, blurs contact-name/phone/email, and asserts queryByTestId('form-error-summary') is null. Minor; non-blocking. Can be folded into a later frontend-hardening pass.

Evaluation (iteration 1/10): VERDICT PASS. AC-006 met, V-006 covered end-to-end vs the real stack, no critical/high/major security findings. Completeness: Active/Removed StatusChip (text always present, color not sole signal); include-removed toggle rendered only under tenants.view_removed AND listTenants passes canViewRemoved&&includeRemoved so a de-permissioned client never requests removed rows; form name-required + email-format + inline blur/submit errors; +New/Remove/Restore gated tenants.create/deactivate/restore; tenantsApi matches TenantDto + the six routes exactly, no invented fields. Permission-gating correctly UX-only: every TenantEndpoints route independently RequirePermission on the correct code under the X-Tenant-Id-exempt GlobalGroup; frontend codes documented UX-only, mirror PermissionCatalog.Tenants; nav gated + RouteGuard Forbidden; e2e no-permission (e2e-rm) confirms nav absent + /admin/tenants -> forbidden-page against the real stack; no cross-tenant leak. Both bug fixes GENUINE not test-hacks: ConfirmDialog testId on the position:fixed overlay (default preserved, only 2 consumers), handleBlur no longer stores undefined keys (real correctness fix for the phantom error-summary banner; validation + server problem+json mapping intact). 46 component tests meaningful (module-boundary mocked, appropriate for component level); V-006 Playwright drives create->Active, edited email persists, danger dialog restates soft-delete, remove->hidden, include-removed->Removed chip, restore->Active, plus AC-016 no-permission/Forbidden - all passing.
